title: Field-extension-local surjectivity of a moduli functor
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$ be categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ and let $f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be a functor over that base, using the categories, functors, discrete representable groupoids and $2$-isomorphisms of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Define $f$ to be surjective in the field-extension-local sense as follows. For every field $K$ [def-weil-field] in the base scheme universe, every $S$-structure $b:\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and every functor $y:h_{(\operatorname{Spec}K,b)}\to\mathcal G$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, there exist a field $L$ in the same universe, a unital field homomorphism $i:K\to L$ (hence an embedding), and a functor $x:h_{(\operatorname{Spec}L,b\circ\operatorname{Spec}(i))}\to\mathcal F$, together with a $2$-isomorphism $f\circ x\simeq y\circ h_{\operatorname{Spec}(i)}$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S$. The two category object and morphism universes are independently variable. This predicate specifies the actual restriction along $\operatorname{Spec}(i)$ and the actual comparison isomorphism; no lift is part of its input.
